answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 14507 Country: INDIA Title: what are the farz , when two muslims meets. In a MNC if we are saying Good Morning or Good Evening instead of Salama , is this fine. Please explain if possible with refrence. Question: what are the farz , when two muslims meets. In a MNC if we are saying Good Morning or Good Evening instead of Salama , is this fine. Please explain if possible with refrence. Answer ID: 14507 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1059/862=L/1430) A Muslim should greet (with السلام علیکم ) while meeting his Muslim brother. Greeting with ?good morning? and ?good evening? is not an Islamic way; therefore it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
